releases.notes:
# DungeonRunTracker 1.1.0

This is a huge update that rewrites most of DRT, with a new UI, much better dungeon and Kuudra tracking, improved Croesus stuff, new statistics sharing, and a lot of fixes

Thanks to everyone who helped test the rewrite and reported issues, there were a lot of them

**Supported versions:** Minecraft 26.2 and 26.3

## New

- **Completely new DRT interface** with five tabs:
  - **Overview:** Your run totals, profit, averages and general statistics
  - **Runs:** Browse completed dungeon and Kuudra runs, with timings, teammates and linked loot
  - **Loot:** View individual chest purchases, rewards, costs and profit
  - **Overlay:** Configure the HUD, layouts, presets and visibility
  - **Settings:** All DRT configuration in one place
- Added **custom themes** for the new interface, there will be a channel to share them, they're very easy to make
- Added **Statistics Sharing**, allowing DRT to upload your dungeon stats so i can make a general dungeons database
- Added Minecraft **26.3 support**
- Added more detailed loot history, including individual chest records and their relationship to completed runs

## Improvements

### Dungeon and Kuudra tracking

- Significantly reworked how runs are detected, completed, recorded and associated with loot
- Improved handling of lobby changes, Dungeon Hub warps and opening chests long after completing a run
- Improved run timing and completion detection
- Improved handling of multiple reward chests belonging to the same run
- Improved Kuudra tier detection, reward capture and run timing
- Improved Kuudra key cost calculations, including faction materials, shop prices and discounts

### Loot and profit

- Reworked chest capture to better combine information from Hypixel chat and reward inventories
- Improved detection of rare rewards, enchanted books, essence and other dungeon drops
- Improved Kismet Feather tracking, including consecutive rerolls
- Improved chest cost breakdowns and profit calculations
- Improved duplicate detection without discarding legitimate identical chest purchases
- Improved pricing via my api
- Improved the handling of missing price data
- Simplified ultimate enchantment names in Loot, for example, Ultimate Bank I now displays as Bank I while keeping its rarity styling
- Improved individual chest selection, filtering and navigation

### Interface and overlays

- Reorganised DRT into a single, more compact interface instead of separate screens and commands
- Improved HUD configuration, presets, positioning, scaling and visibility controls
- Improved the custom overlay editor and its previews
- Improved Croesus chest profit information and highlighting
- Updated setup for the redesigned interface and new options
- Improved button alignment, spacing, tooltips and general usability
- Improved bug reporting and diagnostic tools

### Reliability

- Improved configuration persistence and compatibility with existing saved data
- Improved tracking safeguards to avoid incorrect or duplicate records
- Improved reporting when Hypixel provides incomplete or conflicting information
- Expanded automated testing across dungeon tracking, Kuudra, Croesus, pricing, interface logic and data handling
- Improved compatibility across both supported Minecraft versions

## Fixes

- Fixed Croesus associating multiple unrelated chest purchases with the wrong run
- Fixed chests becoming unlinked when unrelated or older Croesus entries appeared
- Fixed linked chests sometimes displaying **Time unavailable** despite their runs having valid completion times
- Fixed multiple chests from the same run hiding each other in Loot
- Fixed certain runs incorrectly showing **No loot** despite having linked rewards
- Fixed rare rewards occasionally being missed when Hypixel sent reward messages in an unexpected order
- Fixed some reward captures being recorded before the full chest contents were available

...

releases.notes:
## DRT 1.0.11

Kuudra fixes and other fixes

## Kuudra
- Key costs are now read directly from the Mage Shop and Barbarian Shop for Basic through Infernal
- Key prices include your own discounts like emissary reputation and Seal of the Family
- Tiers you haven't seen in the shop yet still use the old reputation-based estimate
- Your Kuudra pet perk now increases Crimson Essence value
- Added a new Essence shards +N% setting for extra Crimson Essence value (`/drt config`)
- Essence amounts with commas like 2,500 now parse properly
- Basic Kuudra chests are no longer counted as Hot
- Plain Kuudra reward chat lines without a header are now read as loot
- Free chests containing only Crimson Essence no longer trigger a false flag

## Chest tracking fixes
- Chests that fail to open are no longer logged
- Open cost is recorded correctly again instead of being saved as 0
- If the price feed briefly misses bazaar or auction data, the previous prices are kept instead of items dropping to 0 value
- Normal storage like island chests, ender chests, backpacks and minions no longer shows the reward chest overlay or gets read as loot

## Loot history
- Value, cost and profit in the loot list now use current prices and current key costs instead of the values saved when the chest was opened
- Added `/drt debug reprice` to update the saved values of old chest records
- You can also use `reprice <chest number>` to reprice a single chest

## Update notice
- DRT now checks for updates when you join
- The update message can tell you if DRT or BetterPV is outdated
- Added a `[Get new update]` button
- The message also includes a `Join the discord!` link

## Other changes
- Version bumped to 1.0.11
- Builds are now only made for 26.1.2 and 26.2

releases.notes:
### DRT 1.0.10

cosmetics and detection fixes

**new stuff**
- Added shared cosmetic rendering between DRT, BetterPV and Skylist so they no longer fight for rendering priority
- Added a **Hide UI** button to the overlay (open inv to see it)

**loot fixes**
- Fixed some loot items having no icon
- Fixed some loot not being counted correctly
- Enchanted books now log properly when Hypixel only shows `Enchanted Book`

**detection fixes**
- Chest tier is now resolved correctly when the chest opens as `Master Catacombs - Floor X`

**pricing fixes**
- Kuudra Vitality books now use their old Mana price entries for pricing
- Fixed pricing for Crimson and other essences
- Switched prices from `athen.aerii.xyz/prices` to `api.vyriv.dev/v1/prices`

**reports**
- Usernames are now hidden from bug report paths
- Added `openfolder <reportId>` for opening report folders

**other**
- Updated for both 26.1.2 and 26.2
- Various smaller fixes and cleanup throughout the mod

releases.notes:
### DRT update
 
Tons of bug fixes, ty for reports
 
 **new stuff**
- Croesus overlay are better colour highlighted based on how many chests are opened ect
   - Green means no chests have been opened
   - Yellow means one chest has been opened and DRT deems it profitable to open another one
   - Grey/Less visible means One has been opened and no other chests are profit, or two have been opened.
   - Plus a little kismet icon
 
 **fixes**
 - browsing chests no longer makes the previous profit overlay linger in the croesus menu
 - loot tracking hopefully no longer duplicates while also allowing identical chests to log
 - removed alot of false spams related to kuudra chests, smaller chests
 - tighter pending chest handling, correct floor assignment for logs (less spam)
-  fixed that two identical chests would be counted as one run

releases.notes:
### DRT update

pretty big tracking/bugfix update

**new stuff**
- `/drt toggle` is split into **UI, tracking, CroOverlay and essence** now
- added **Mod Menu support**, opens the normal DRT setup/config (thanks <@238809504374980618>)
- kuudra keys now account for **reputation discounts**
- cosmetics moved over to my API
- completely reworked how **runs/chests are tracked**
- added proper **bug reports + debug zips** so tracking issues should be WAY easier to figure out

**fixes**
- fixed same-tier croesus loot sometimes not counting properly, especially rare drops
- fixed croesus getting confused after doing kuudra
- late croesus chests can now reconnect to the correct run for up to **15 mins**, even after restarting
- fixed essence `xN` parsing + duplicate GUI stacks
- orphaned chests won't just make up a fake run anymore
- incomplete/truncated loot captures now get flagged
- config saves are safer + have a backup now

**also coming with it**
- reset buttons need a confirmation now so you can't accidentally wipe stuff
- fixed double clicking **Reset F7** sometimes triggering **Reset All**
- run counts are restored from completions now, deleting loot won't delete runs
- dropping support for 1.21.11
